meta_description: Sam's Electrical Services Ltd offer trusted electrical work across Manchester. NICEIC-approved, fast response, free quotes. Call today for a reliable local electrician.
hero_eyebrow: NICEIC Approved Contractor — Free No-Obligation Quotes
hero_subhead: Faulty wiring, a full rewire, or a new consumer unit — we get it sorted safely, on time and on budget.
services_subhead: From minor repairs to full property rewires, Sam's Electrical Services covers every electrical need for homeowners and businesses throughout Greater Manchester.

services.title: Full & Partial Rewires
services.desc: We carry out full and partial rewires on homes of all ages, ensuring your property meets current BS 7671 wiring regulations. All work is inspected, tested, and certificated on completion.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: An outdated fuse board is a safety risk and an insurance concern. We supply and fit modern consumer units with RCD protection, improving safety and bringing your installation up to current standards.

services.title: Electrical Installation Condition Reports (EICR)
services.desc: Landlords and homeowners can rely on us for thorough periodic inspection and testing. We issue official EICR certificates recognised by letting agents, insurers, and local authorities.

services.title: Socket & Lighting Installations
services.desc: Need extra sockets, USB outlets, or a new lighting circuit? We install cleanly and efficiently, minimising disruption and leaving your home exactly as we found it — just with better electrics.

services.title: Fault Finding & Repairs
services.desc: Tripping breakers, dead sockets, or flickering lights can signal a serious underlying fault. Our methodical diagnostic approach pinpoints the problem quickly so it's fixed safely the first time.

services.title: EV Charger Installation
services.desc: We supply and install home electric vehicle charging points compatible with all major car brands. Installations are completed to OZEV standards, and we can advise on the best charger for your setup.

about_pullquote: Every job gets the same care, whether it's one socket or a full rewire.
about_para_1: Sam's Electrical Services Ltd was founded by Sam, a fully qualified electrician based in Old Trafford, Stretford. With over 15 years of hands-on experience working across domestic and light commercial properties in Manchester, Sam built the business on a simple promise: honest advice, quality workmanship, and a tidy finish every time.
about_para_2: Operating from our base on Skerton Road, we serve homeowners, landlords, and small businesses throughout Greater Manchester. Customers return to us because we turn up when we say we will, explain everything clearly, and never recommend work that isn't genuinely needed. Our reputation has grown almost entirely through word of mouth — and we intend to keep it that way.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Sam's Electrical Services

reviews.text: Sam replaced our consumer unit and added a couple of extra circuits for the kitchen. Arrived on time, explained everything before starting, and left the place spotless. Would absolutely recommend to anyone looking for a trustworthy electrician in Manchester.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Really impressed with the service. We needed an EICR for our rental property and Sam turned it around quickly with a full written report. Straightforward, professional, and very fairly priced. We'll be using Sam for all our electrical work going forward.
reviews.author: Priya S.

reviews.text: Had a persistent tripping issue that two other electricians couldn't sort. Sam diagnosed the fault within the hour and had it fixed the same day. Brilliant service — honest, efficient, and no messing about. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James O.
